title: The Eye of Knowledge Sees
devanagari: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।
translation: Whether it is leaving, staying or enjoying, joined with the gunas, the deluded do not see it. Those with the eye of knowledge see it.
translation_hi: जीवात्मा शरीर छोड़ता हो, उसमें रहता हो या गुणों से युक्त होकर भोग करता हो, मूढ़ लोग उसे नहीं देखते। ज्ञान रूपी नेत्र वाले उसे देखते हैं।

words.meaning: those with the eye of knowledge
